BiblicalUsage: Sarah is Abraham's wife, and her name is the one God gave her: Sarai she was called, but Sarah she shall be. She conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time God had spoken of, and the prophets still point back to her — look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sarah's story is the proof that God's promise does not wait on human timing. She bore the child of promise when age said it was over, and that is why her name still stands beside Abraham's.
RelatedEvents: The Covenant of Circumcision; The Birth of Isaac
